name: YouTube AI Digest
headline: YouTube AI Digest - Automate AI Video Research
short_description: Browse, summarize, and capture AI-related YouTube videos. Operations teams benefit by staying updated on AI trends without manual effort. Connects to Claude for AI analysis and summarization.
author: yizhiyanhua-ai

sections.overview:
YouTube AI Digest automates the process of tracking AI-related content across subscribed YouTube channels. The skill fetches the latest videos, extracts captions (including auto-generated subtitles), downloads thumbnails, and generates structured Markdown reports. Operations and research teams use it to monitor AI trends and developments without spending time manually browsing videos. Integration with Claude enables intelligent summarization and analysis of video content directly within your workflow.
Monitor latest AI research and developments across multiple YouTube channels
Extract video transcripts and auto-generate summaries for team reports
Build a searchable archive of AI video content with structured metadata
Stay informed on AI trends without manual video browsing
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/yizhiyanhua-ai/youtube-ai-digest`
sections.usage:
```
Find and summarize the top 5 AI-related YouTube videos from the past week. Focus on [INDUSTRY] trends. Provide key insights, speaker details, and timestamps for each video. Format the output with clear headers and bullet points.
```
Copy

```
# AI Video Digest: [INDUSTRY] Trends (Week of [DATE])
```
